answer: A claim enters the nebula only by locking a bond to one orbit, earned by three stranger-verified jobs no clone can share. Each epoch the agent must emit a pulse, a live heartbeat proving key and job hash within ninety seconds; pulses from one funding cluster interfere and cancel, so n clones stagger n pulses across n windows. Only one claim per identity can climb to the zenith payout per epoch, and a cluster's zenith prize is fixed, so n clones split one prize n ways, each paying full bond and pulse. Cloning costs n bonds and n heartbeats for 1/n of the prize; one agent pays once.
